sources.title: LFM2.5-8B-A1B - Liquid Docs
sources.snippet: 8B parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 1.5B active parameters for fast, reliable tool calling and 128K context ← Back to Text Models LFM2.5-8B-A1B is Liquid AI's Mixture-of-Experts model, combining 8B total parameters with only 1.5B active parameters per forward pass with a 128K context window and chain of thought reasoning.

sources.title: flackzz/LFM2.5-8B-A1B-ONNX-Q4F16-resharded · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: LFM2.5-8B-A1B is a Mixture of Experts model with 8B total parameters and about 1B active parameters per token. It uses 32 experts with 4 experts activated per token, combining the efficiency of sparse models with the quality of larger dense models.

sources.title: LFM2 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: With increased reasoning data allocation, LFM2-8B-A1B yields substantial gains over the 2.6B model, including +10.6 points on MATH 500 and +8 points on MATH Level 5.
